title: B&G Ecocirc: E06 voltage imbalance
equipment: B&G Ecocirc circulator (field-derived draft; E06 meaning and +/-10% range are field-reported)

n1.text: Record the pump model, fault history and supply type. Does the problem line up with generator operation, a building shutdown or another electrical event?

r_event.cause: The supply is the likely trigger.
fix: Investigate the source: generator output, transfer equipment and upstream electrical gear.
A qualified person should measure the incoming supply with appropriate PPE and procedures.
Compare readings with the exact pump manual, including whether the limit is imbalance, deviation or another measurement.
Correct the electrical issue before returning the pump to service.

n2.text: A qualified person measures the incoming supply and checks connections. Are readings outside the manual limit?

r_intermit.cause: The problem may be intermittent and not present during a single measurement.
fix: Review event timing, supply records, connections and manufacturer diagnostics.
Do not conclude the pump is healthy from one normal reading.
Do not repeatedly reset without investigating the supply.
Monitor through a representative operating period and through the condition tied to the original fault.
